is_training.description: Training event: a simple event with a multi-day agenda of EventAgendaItem lines (Task #3419)

is_unlimited_registration.description: If true, event has no seat limit (open registration). If false/null, use available_seats to track capacity.

backstage_ticket_type_id.description: Zoho Backstage ticket type ID for this event's main ticket

backstage_public_url.description: Public Backstage event page URL for attendees

image_focal_point.description: Focal point coordinates for the event image (percentages). Used for smart cropping.

show_ticket_availability.description: If true, show ticket class availability counts to users on the event details page

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the event. Must be unique per tenant. Used for friendly URLs like /events/my-event-name

is_featured.description: If true, event is featured and displayed prominently at the top of event listings

xero_account_code.description: Optional Xero nominal ledger / account code for this event. Overrides the system default xero_sales_account_code when generating invoices.

attached_documents.description: Public documents (programmes, agendas, info packs) rendered on the event page. PDFs open in an in-page viewer; other files open in a new tab.

documents_section_title.description: Heading shown above the documents list on the public event page (e.g. "Programmes"). Falls back to "Documents" when blank.

dietary_options.description: Admin-defined Dietary Requirement options registrants can choose from per attendee. Empty/absent = group hidden.

allergy_options.description: Admin-defined Allergy options (a subsection of Dietary). Registrants multi-select, each with a Mild/Moderate/Severe severity. Empty/absent = group hidden.

accessibility_options.description: Admin-defined Accessibility Need options registrants can choose from per attendee. Empty/absent = group hidden.

cta_button_label.description: Optional per-event CTA button label for event cards; blank/null falls back to the tenant-wide event_cta_button system setting

replace_booking_elements.description: TBC events only: when true, the public detail page replaces ticket price / booking summary cards with booking_replacement_message and the confirm button (booking action unchanged)

booking_replacement_message.description: Helper message shown in place of the standard booking elements when replace_booking_elements is on (TBC events)

booking_replacement_cta_label.description: Overrides the 'Confirm Booking' button text when replace_booking_elements is on (TBC events)

speaker_award_config.description: Speaker awards granted at event start: { enabled, default: { voucher_value, voucher_expiry, badge_id }, overrides: { <speakerId>: { excluded } | { voucher_value, voucher_expiry, badge_id } } }

speaker_awards_granted_at.description: Set by the grant cron once speaker awards for this event have been processed
